title: NASA: Space Race Milestones
description: From Mercury missions to Mars rovers, the incredible journey of America's space program
imageHint: 🚀 One giant leap for mankind and beyond 🌙

questions.question: Who was the first American astronaut to orbit Earth in 1962?
questions.hint: His first name is John, and he later became a U.S. Senator

questions.question: What was the name of the NASA program that successfully landed humans on the Moon?
questions.hint: Named after a Greek god, this program achieved Kennedy's goal of lunar landing

questions.question: Which space shuttle tragically exploded 73 seconds after launch in 1986?
questions.hint: It carried teacher Christa McAuliffe and was named after a British naval research vessel

questions.question: What is the name of NASA's Mars rover that landed in 2021 and is searching for signs of ancient life?
questions.hint: Named for the quality of continuing despite difficulties, nicknamed 'Percy'

deeperMode.title: Mission Control Secrets
deeperMode.description: The hidden stories and critical moments that defined space exploration

questions.question: What phrase did flight controllers use to describe the successful problem-solving during Apollo 13's crisis?
questions.hint: A famous movie quote that became NASA's unofficial motto during crises

questions.question: NASA's Deep Space Network uses giant radio dishes to communicate with spacecraft. What is the diameter of the largest dishes?
questions.hint: About the length of a football field, these dishes can hear a whisper from billions of miles away
